name: WANTED: Marez Cowl

angles.text: The Alliance garrison at Refuge Pointe, led by Captain Nials, fights to reclaim Stromgarde. High-ranking Syndicate leaders like Marez Cowl are strategic priorities.
Marez Cowl belongs to the Syndicate’s darker occult wing. Her use of demonic summoning shows how political renegades turn to demons to extend their influence.
As a warlock who deals openly with demons in the ruins of an ancient human kingdom, Cowl affronts the Holy Light and Stromgarde’s defense.

faq.answer: Marez Cowl is a high-ranking Syndicate advisor and operative. She wields influence in the organization and is a dangerous warlock who traffics with demons.
Marez Cowl is in the Syndicate-held part of ruined Stromgarde, in the Arathi Highlands. Criminal forces are entrenched there, and you must find your way through them to reach her lair.
The Alliance military in the Arathi Highlands offers the bounty. Captain Nials, commander of the Alliance stronghold at Refuge Pointe, oversees it.
faq.q: Who posted the bounty on Marez Cowl?

faq.answer: Marez Cowl is wanted for her Syndicate leadership and her use of demonic summoning in Stromgarde. She threatens the Alliance garrison trying to reclaim the ruined kingdom.
faq.q: Why is there a bounty on her head?

faq.answer: Marez Cowl uses warlock magic to summon and bargain with demons. Take extreme care when confronting her and the demons she commands.
faq.q: What kind of magic does Marez Cowl use?

aliases: where turn in marez cowl bounty
faq.answer: After Marez Cowl is slain, deliver her head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe, the Alliance outpost in the Arathi Highlands.
faq.q: Where do you turn in the bounty for Marez Cowl?

sections.body: At Refuge Pointe, Alliance commanders offer a bounty on a high-ranking Syndicate leader. Marez Cowl advises the Syndicate and directs its work in Stromgarde’s ruins as a field operative. The bounty aims to break the group’s local command.
sections.title: A Price on Syndicate Leadership

sections.body: Marez Cowl is a warlock among the Syndicate’s brigands and dispossessed nobles. She deals openly with demonic powers to enforce her will and defend Syndicate territory. To reach her lair in Stromgarde, you must face armed criminals and the demons she commands.
sections.title: The Warlock of Stromgarde

summary: At Stromgarde, Marez Cowl advises Syndicate leaders and traffics with demons. Her influence threatens Alliance forces in the Arathi Highlands.
attribution: In-game quest text: WANTED: Marez Cowl
